# GetSamplerBorderColorR 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
GetSamplerBorderColorR:Float32 sampler:Int32
```

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Returns the red part of the border color that the sampler has, as it was set with [SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor) (or the default of [CreateSampler](CreateSampler)). This is a BlitzLLVM extension. The value is the one that the sampler keeps, which is the one that was given after it was kept inside what is accepted: 0 to 1.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | Int32 | required | The sampler to ask. |

**Returns:** The setting: 0 to 1.
